arguments.summary: A coordinated attack originated from a compromised finance workstation (WS-FIN-042, 10.0.5.42) that was infected with Cobalt Strike beaconing to external C2. The threat actor conducted lateral movement attempts and credential theft, leading to exposure of admin_jsmith's credentials on the dark web. Multiple alerts—including SSH brute-force (via proxy IP 10.0.5.14), credential leak, and anomalous Kerberos access from IT workstation (10.0.6.99)—were correlated to this incident. Immediate actions included credential revocation and network containment.

timeline.description: Initial compromise: WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) establishes outbound HTTPS connection to C2 server 198.51.100.23.
Malicious process execution via rundll32 from temp directory on WS-FIN-042.
IDS detects Cobalt Strike beaconing from WS-FIN-042 to C2 infrastructure.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating credential dumping or pass-the-hash preparation.
Lateral movement via SMB to internal file server (10.0.5.50) using compromised user CORP\jsmith credentials.
Brute-force SSH attack detected from proxy IP 10.0.5.14 targeting bastion host; traced back to WS-FIN-042.
Dark web monitoring detects admin_jsmith credentials in breach paste; hash matches current AD password.
Anomalous Kerberos TGT request for admin_jsmith observed from unassigned device WS-IT-101 (10.0.6.99).
Incident response initiated; true source identified as WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42).
Credentials for admin_jsmith revoked and host WS-FIN-042 isolated from network.

arguments.summary: A coordinated attack originating from a compromised finance workstation (WS-FIN-042) led to the exposure and misuse of the privileged account 'admin_jsmith'. The incident began with a Cobalt Strike beacon installation on 2026-04-09, followed by lateral movement and credential theft. On 2026-04-11, the compromised credentials were used in a brute-force attempt from the internal network and subsequently appeared on a dark web paste, confirming credential exfiltration. Anomalous Kerberos requests from an unauthorized device indicated active exploitation. The account was successfully revoked, and the source host scanned for malware.

timeline.description: Initial access: Outbound HTTPS connection from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to known C2 server (198.51.100.23).
Suspicious rundll32 execution detected on WS-FIN-042, indicative of payload execution.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, suggesting credential dumping attempts.
Lateral movement via SMB to file server (10.0.5.50) using admin_jsmith credentials.
SSH brute-force attack initiated from internal IP 10.0.5.14 targeting bastion host 10.0.3.77 using admin_jsmith and other usernames.
Dark web monitoring detects admin_jsmith credentials in a public paste dump; hash matches current AD password.
Anomalous Kerberos TGS request for admin_jsmith from unauthorized workstation 10.0.6.99.
UEBA system flags admin_jsmith with critical risk score (0.92) due to anomalous login time, geolocation, and lateral movement.
IAM system revokes all sessions and API keys for admin_jsmith.
EPP completes full scan of WS-FIN-042; detects and quarantines Linux dropper malware.
